verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a native Linear feature for building dashboards or widgets to report on project progress. The only dashboard mention, "Build custom dashboards and analytics from issue and project data", is a listing on the integrations directory. That points to a third-party integration rather than Linear's own capability. Fivetran/Airbyte data sync, shareable filtered views and project-view notifications are adjacent features or external tools, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can build dashboards and widgets to report on project progress
